risks.title: Dependence on macroeconomic and real estate market conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned at the outset of the 10-K and characterized as 'significantly impacted'. The intensity of language is high, underscoring potential impact on operations, results and financial position. The 2025 context shows persistent challenges: inflation, interest rates, customer financing.

risks.title: Risks related to AI adoption and governance
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed over several pages of the 10-K with strong language: 'emerging risks', 'adversely affect'. It is new relative to traditional macroeconomic risks and its importance is underscored by investments and potential implications for competitiveness and reputation.

risks.title: Dependence on talent recruitment and retention
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified as critical for revenue generation. Language is strong: 'materially adversely affect', 'significant competition'. Increased competition and financial incentives are aggravating factors.

risks.title: International geopolitical and regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described over multiple paragraphs of the 10-K with an extensive list of potential factors: political instability, conflicts, regulatory complexity. Impact on operations, financial position and results is characterized as 'materially affect'.

risks.title: Foreign currency volatility
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned specifically with quantification of exposure. Impact on results is characterized as 'fluctuations' and 'adverse', and uncertainty regarding future impact is emphasized.

risks.title: Risks related to sociopolitical polarization
risks.score_rationale: This risk is new and may affect operations of a global enterprise. It notes potential impacts on reputation, customer attraction, team management and economic stability.

risks.title: Corruption and international compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly stated with examples of laws: FCPA, sanctions. Failure to succeed in prevention can result in material fines and penalties, impacting finances and reputation.

ai_positioning.summary: CWK recognizes emerging risks related to AI adoption and governance, but does not detail a distinct AI strategy in its current operations. AI is mentioned as a potential risk in terms of deployment, data and algorithm governance, as well as increased competition.
evidence: Risks detailed on pages 13-14 of the 10-K regarding AI adoption and governance
Issues of data and algorithm quality, as well as competitive implications
